renewable.heroSubtitle: IEC-compliant thermal and visual inspections for solar farms and wind turbines across Europe. Identify revenue-draining faults, soiling, and degradation — delivered in 48 hours, at a fraction of ground-based cost.
renewable.solarDesc: Our IEC 62446-3 compliant thermal imaging inspections identify hotspots, degraded strings, soiling, and panel misalignment across utility-scale solar installations. AI-powered fault classification prioritises findings by revenue impact — not just temperature delta.
renewable.solarF0: IEC 62446-3 compliant data capture and reporting
renewable.solarF1: Simultaneous thermal IR and RGB at prescribed GSD
renewable.solarF2: AI classification: hotspots, PID, soiling, bypass diode faults
renewable.solarF3: Geo-referenced defect maps for maintenance crews
renewable.solarF4: Up to 50 MW inspected per day
renewable.windDesc: Advanced drone technology for comprehensive wind turbine inspections, detecting blade surface defects, leading edge erosion, lightning strike damage, and structural anomalies. Delivered in collaboration with Sulzer Schmid Laboratories AG using 3DX photogrammetric reconstruction.
renewable.windF1: Leading edge erosion and crack detection
renewable.windF3: 3DX technology in collaboration with Sulzer Schmid
renewable.thermalDesc: Drag the divider to compare a standard RGB drone image against thermal imaging — revealing hotspots and degraded cells invisible to the naked eye.
renewable.thermalNote: Thermal anomalies indicate degraded cells, soiling, and connection faults — identified remotely at scale across hundreds of MW per day.
renewable.p0Desc: We review panel layout, capacity, and any historical fault data before mobilisation to define flight paths and GSD requirements.
renewable.p1Desc: Simultaneous thermal IR and RGB flight at IEC 62446-3 prescribed GSDs. Data validated for completeness on-site before crew departure.
renewable.p2Desc: Automated anomaly detection pipeline classifies hotspots, degraded strings, soiling, and module-level faults by type and severity.
renewable.p3Desc: Structured defect report with geo-referenced fault locations, severity scores, and maintenance prioritisation — delivered within 48 hours.
renewable.t0Desc: Every solar inspection follows the international standard for thermographic testing of PV installations.
renewable.t1Desc: Machine learning pipeline categorises anomalies by type and estimated revenue impact — not just temperature delta.
renewable.t2Desc: Structured, geo-referenced defect reports ready for maintenance scheduling within 48 hours of data capture.
renewable.ctaSub: Discover how drone inspections can optimise your renewable energy assets.

infra.heroSubtitle: Drone inspections for powerlines, gas pipelines, telecom towers, and rail corridors. Replace rope access and manual patrols with rapid aerial coverage — delivering GPS-tagged defect reports without shutting down the asset.
infra.telecomDesc: Full visual and condition inspection of telecom towers without the cost, risk, or scheduling delays of rope access crews. GPS-tagged defect reports ready for your asset management system.
infra.tc0Desc: High-resolution close-visual and thermal imaging for early identification of structural deterioration, corrosion, antenna misalignment, and mounting hardware defects.
infra.tc1Desc: Accurate terrain and obstruction data for optimal new tower placement analysis and radio frequency planning.
infra.tc2Desc: 3D terrain modelling and coverage simulation for efficient network expansion, densification, and optimisation decisions.
infra.tc3Desc: Rapid aerial assessment after storm damage, flooding, or other incidents — supporting fast restoration without endangering personnel.
infra.powerDesc: Aerial inspection of transmission and distribution networks at scale — detecting conductor damage, thermal hotspots, and vegetation encroachment across hundreds of kilometres per engagement.
infra.pl0Desc: Comprehensive detection of conductor damage, insulator degradation, and vegetation encroachment along transmission and distribution corridors.
infra.pl1Desc: Thermal hotspot detection on connections, fittings, and insulators — identifying equipment failure risks before they cause outages.
infra.pl2Desc: 3D corridor modelling for statutory clearance analysis, vegetation management planning, and sag/blow-out calculations.
infra.pl3Desc: Automated encroachment detection and clearance zone monitoring to support vegetation management contractors and network operators.
infra.w0Desc: EASA Specific Category licensed crew. No personnel required in hazardous zones, at height, or in confined spaces.
infra.w1Desc: Cover 40 km of linear assets per day versus a fraction of that with traditional ground or rope-access crews.
infra.w2Desc: Every defect location is precisely geo-referenced, exportable to GIS and asset management platforms.
infra.w3Desc: Eliminate scaffolding, rope access, and road closure costs while capturing higher-quality visual data.
infra.ctaTitle: Get in Touch to Learn More
infra.ctaSub: Discover how drone inspections can transform your infrastructure operations.

oilgas.heroSubtitle: Aerial inspections for pipelines, refineries, and offshore platforms. Cover 40 km per day, eliminate hazardous manual access, and receive structured defect reports — without disrupting operations.
oilgas.stat0Sub: vs. under 5 km with ground crews
oilgas.s0Desc: Aerial inspections via rapid data capture and off-site specialist evaluation dramatically reduce operational downtime. Full structured reports with high-resolution imagery allow engineering decisions to be made without extended field visits or asset shutdowns.
oilgas.s0F0: Rapid aerial data capture in minutes per km
oilgas.s0F4: DAM-compatible data formats for easy integration
oilgas.s1Desc: Aerata drones safely inspect offshore rigs, refineries, tank farms, and pipeline networks — removing the need for personnel to work at height, in confined spaces, or in hazardous atmospheric environments. Our platforms are weather-rated for continuous field operations.
oilgas.s1F0: No personnel required in hazardous zones
oilgas.s1F1: Offshore rig and platform structural inspections
oilgas.s1F2: Pipeline corridor monitoring — 40 km per day
oilgas.s1F4: IP45-rated platforms for adverse weather operations
oilgas.p0Desc: We work with your HSE and operations teams to plan flight corridors, identify no-fly zones, and secure required operational permits.
oilgas.p1Desc: Multi-sensor data capture including high-resolution RGB, thermal IR, and LiDAR along the asset corridor — in a single mobilisation.
oilgas.p2Desc: Specialist data review identifies corrosion, cracks, leaks, coating failures, third-party encroachments, and vegetation threats.
oilgas.p3Desc: Structured defect reports with GPS-tagged locations, imagery, severity scores, and recommended actions — delivered within 48 hours.
oilgas.t0Desc: Drone inspections eliminate the need to put personnel in hazardous environments, reducing RIDDOR incident risk to near zero on inspection activities.
oilgas.t1Desc: Inspections run without shutting down the asset. Pipelines, tanks, and platforms are assessed live — no production downtime required.
oilgas.t2Desc: Every finding is geo-referenced and exportable to your asset management and GIS systems. Full photo evidence library included.
oilgas.t3Desc: DJI Matrice 300/350 RTK with thermal, zoom, and LiDAR payloads. IP45-rated for operation in rain, wind, and cold environments.
oilgas.ctaSub: Learn how drone operations can reduce costs and improve safety across your oil & gas assets.

environment.heroSubtitle: High-resolution aerial surveys for habitat mapping, biodiversity assessment, water quality monitoring, and precision agriculture. Multispectral and thermal data collected at scale — delivered in compliance-ready GIS formats.
environment.s0Desc: Drone-based environmental monitoring delivers accurate habitat mapping, pollution detection, and comprehensive ecosystem assessments. Multi-spectral and thermal sensors provide the data resolution needed for informed conservation and regulatory compliance decisions.
environment.s0F1: Water quality and pollution gradient detection
environment.s0F2: Coastal erosion and intertidal zone monitoring
environment.s1Desc: AI-driven analytics for species identification, population estimation, and change detection across protected areas and development site footprints. Drone surveys produce detailed maps and reports that support conservation planning and statutory ecological assessments.
environment.s1F0: AI-assisted species identification from aerial imagery
environment.s1F1: Population density estimation across survey areas
environment.s1F3: Detailed biodiversity reports and GIS maps
environment.s2Desc: Optimise crop health, irrigation efficiency, and nutrient management with AI-powered drone analytics. NDVI, NDRE, and thermal mapping identify problem zones before they affect yield — enabling targeted intervention rather than blanket treatment.
environment.s2F0: NDVI and NDRE crop health analysis
environment.s2F1: Irrigation efficiency and water stress mapping
environment.s2F2: Nutrient deficiency and disease risk detection
environment.s2F3: Prescription maps for field machinery integration
environment.cap0Desc: Multispectral mapping of water bodies for chlorophyll-a, turbidity, and NDWI indices. Tracks seasonal change and identifies pollution gradients across reservoirs and catchments.
environment.cap1Desc: Multi-spectral NDVI and classification mapping for habitat assessment, invasive species detection, and biodiversity baseline surveys in support of conservation and regulatory compliance.
environment.cap2Desc: High-resolution orthomosaics and DSMs for coastal erosion monitoring, intertidal zone mapping, and protected habitat assessments.
environment.cap3Desc: NDVI, NDRE, and thermal crop health mapping for targeted irrigation, fertiliser, and intervention planning — delivered as prescription maps for field machinery.
environment.p0Desc: Sensor selection, flight altitude, GSD, and temporal frequency defined to match the environmental variable being monitored.
environment.p1Desc: Simultaneous RGB, thermal, and/or multispectral data capture at prescribed altitudes. Radiometric calibration panels captured at flight start and end.
environment.p2Desc: Radiometrically corrected reflectance maps, index calculation (NDVI, NDWI, NDRE), and classification layers generated from raw data.
environment.p3Desc: GeoTIFF rasters, shapefiles, and interpretation reports delivered in your required coordinate reference system for direct GIS import.
environment.ctaSub: Contact us for a consultation on environmental monitoring or precision agriculture solutions.

surveying.heroSubtitle: Engineering-grade aerial data for construction, land development, and infrastructure planning. Centimetre-accurate deliverables in GIS, CAD, and BIM-ready formats — captured faster and more safely than ground-based survey crews.
surveying.s0Desc: Using RTK photogrammetry and UAV image stitching, we produce geometrically corrected orthomosaics and detailed 3D models. Our orthophotos provide true-to-scale aerial imagery directly usable in GIS and CAD software, with GCP-controlled accuracy to sub-centimetre.
surveying.s0F1: High-resolution 3D point clouds and mesh models
surveying.s0F2: GIS and CAD compatible outputs (DXF, SHP, GeoTIFF)
surveying.s1Desc: Our LiDAR-equipped drones generate precise Digital Elevation Models and Digital Terrain Models for urban planning, flood modelling, and environmental monitoring. LiDAR penetrates dense vegetation to produce bare-earth models unavailable from photogrammetry alone.
surveying.s1F3: Flood risk assessment and water stream modelling
surveying.s2Desc: Regular aerial surveys with automated progress comparison, volumetric calculations, and as-built versus design analysis. Our drone surveys provide project stakeholders with real-time aerial overviews at every construction phase — from groundworks to final handover.
surveying.s2F0: Automated weekly or fortnightly progress reports
surveying.s2F1: Volume calculations for earthworks and stockpiles
surveying.s3Desc: Aerial data combined with machine learning for anomaly detection, structural change monitoring, and predictive maintenance triggers. Ideal for infrastructure assets that require regular condition assessment over extended timeframes.
surveying.s3F2: Proactive maintenance and early warning alerts
surveying.s3F3: Historical change detection across survey cycles
surveying.capsTitle: What Sets Our Survey Data Apart
surveying.cap0Desc: Real-time kinematic positioning eliminates the need for ground control points on most sites, delivering centimetre-accurate orthomosaics and 3D models faster.
surveying.cap1Desc: Dedicated LiDAR sensors generate dense, classified point clouds that penetrate vegetation canopy — essential for terrain modelling beneath tree cover.
surveying.cap2Desc: Drone surveys cover large areas in hours, not days. A typical 100-hectare site is fully captured in a single flight with sub-centimetre vertical accuracy.
surveying.cap3Desc: All deliverables are formatted for direct import into AutoCAD, Revit, QGIS, ArcGIS, and BIM workflows — no conversion required.
surveying.p0Desc: Flight path optimisation, GSD specification, and ground control point placement based on required accuracy class.
surveying.p1Desc: Simultaneous RGB, LiDAR, and/or multispectral data capture at prescribed overlap. All data validated on-site.
surveying.p2Desc: Dense point cloud generation, mesh construction, and geometric correction using survey-grade photogrammetry pipelines.
surveying.p3Desc: Orthomosaics, DTMs, DEMs, .LAS point clouds, and Potree web viewer output — in your preferred coordinate system.
surveying.demoDesc: A fully navigable 3D point cloud generated from drone photogrammetry data over a real survey site — the kind of deliverable your team would receive.
surveying.demoNote: Outputs delivered as .LAS / .E57 point clouds, Potree web viewer, or integrated GIS layers.
surveying.ctaSub: Contact us for a free consultation on your surveying or construction monitoring project.

servicesPage.heroTitle: Six services, one standard of evidence
servicesPage.heroSub: Thermal, visual, LiDAR and survey data captured by certified pilots, checked by our analysts and delivered in formats your team already uses.

list.title: PV thermal inspection
list.short: Panels, strings, combiner boxes and inverters in one visit.
list.desc: Panels, strings, combiner boxes and inverters checked in one visit, with every fault located so your operations and maintenance (O&M) team knows what to fix first.
list.detail: We fly when irradiance and weather meet the conditions in IEC TS 62446-3, the standard for aerial thermography of PV plants, so results stay comparable from one year to the next. Combiner boxes and inverters are checked on the ground by our thermographer during the same visit.
list.equipment: Radiometric thermal and zoom cameras, RTK positioning, handheld thermal camera
outputs: Fault list for your O&M system (CSV, KML, SHP)

list.title: Wind turbine inspection
list.short: Blades, tower, nacelle and base equipment, no rope access.
list.desc: Blades, tower, the outside of the nacelle and the electrical equipment at the base, without rope access.
list.detail: The turbine stops for a short time with the blades in a set position. High-resolution zoom images cover each blade from all sides, and every finding is located along the blade so it can be found again at the next inspection.
list.equipment: High-resolution zoom and thermal cameras on enterprise drones
outputs: Report per turbine and per blade

list.title: Power line inspection
list.short: Poles, pylons, fittings, vegetation and clearances, plus substations.
list.desc: Poles and pylons, insulators, fittings, vegetation and conductor clearances along the whole route, plus substations.
list.detail: Visual, thermal and LiDAR data are captured along the route and tied to each pole or pylon, so your crews get a work list in route order instead of a stack of photos.
list.equipment: Zoom and thermal cameras, LiDAR scanner, RTK positioning
outputs: Pole and pylon register with findings

list.title: LiDAR surveying (laser scanning)
list.short: Accurate 3D terrain and asset data, even through vegetation.
list.desc: Accurate 3D terrain and asset data for design and clearance checks, even through vegetation.
list.detail: Laser pulses pass through gaps in the canopy, so we can model the ground under trees and measure conductors, slopes and structures. Accuracy is checked against independent GNSS checkpoints.
list.equipment: Drone LiDAR scanner, GNSS base station and rover

list.title: Photogrammetry and mapping
list.short: Up-to-date maps and 3D models of sites and structures.
list.desc: Up-to-date maps and 3D models of sites, buildings and structures.
list.detail: Overlapping high-resolution photos are processed into orthophotos, surface models and textured 3D models, delivered in your coordinate system and ready to measure on in CAD or GIS.
list.equipment: Full-frame survey camera, mapping drones, RTK and ground control

list.title: Construction-site security and monitoring
list.short: Kooi camera units and DJI Dock drone patrols, monitored 24/7.
list.desc: Visible deterrence and remote monitoring of the site, from the ground and from the air.
list.detail: Mobile camera units from our partner Kooi are connected around the clock to the Kooi Alarm Center. A DJI Dock on site adds automated drone patrols on a schedule or on alarm. A drone survey before installation shows where cameras and the dock should stand.
list.equipment: Kooi UFO mobile camera units, RED fire early warning, DJI Dock with Matrice 4TD thermal drone
outputs: Security map with camera and dock positions
Alarms verified from the ground and the air
Damage records for police and insurer

renewables.menu: Solar and wind: thermal and blade inspection, and construction monitoring.
renewables.seoTitle: Solar & Wind Drone Inspection & Construction Monitoring | Aerata
renewables.seoDesc: Thermal drone inspection of PV plants, wind turbine blade inspection without rope access, and independent construction progress measurement for solar and wind.
renewables.heroSub: Solar plants and wind farms, from the first pile to years of operation: we find the faults that quietly cost you production, and measure what has really been built.

card.o1: The whole PV electrical chain checked in one visit, panel to inverter
card.o2: Every blade inspected with a short stop and no rope access
card.o3: Independent progress measurement for payments and drawdowns

sections.label: Solar in operation
sections.title: Solar power plants in operation
sections.intro: Production loss in a solar plant is quiet. A dead string, a loose connection or an overheating inverter terminal can run for months before it shows in your numbers, and your ground team will not see it. Aerata checks the whole electrical chain in one visit, from the panel to the inverter, so you know what is wrong, where it is and what to fix first.

items.text: Hot spots, cell faults, failed bypass diodes, strings that are switched off or not producing, and soiling and shading patterns, located by plant section.
Our thermographer checks the cabinets where strings join for overheating fuses and loose or degraded cable connections.
Overheating at terminals, connector bars and cable connections, checked at close range while the plant produces.
Broken glass and other visible damage to panels.
BESS and substation checks can be added to the same visit.

sections.closing: Repeat inspections show what is new, what is getting worse and what has been repaired. That is the evidence you need before a warranty ends, after hail or storms, and before a sale or refinancing.

sections.label: Solar construction
sections.title: Solar plant construction
sections.intro: Solar construction money moves on progress claims. Aerata gives owners, lenders and contractors an independent measurement of what has actually been built, section by section, so payments and drawdowns follow facts and errors are caught while they are cheap to fix.

items.text: Piles, mounting tables or trackers, and modules installed.
Excavation, fill and stockpile volumes by zone and period, plus progress on roads, drainage and fencing.
Piles and tables out of position, row alignment, and cable trench routes mapped before backfilling.
Material counts in storage areas, and a monthly progress report with timelapse for your site meeting.
A thermal inspection of the energised plant at handover, while the contractor is still liable for defects.

sections.closing: Reporting is shaped for whoever pays for it: contractor, owner, owner’s engineer or lender’s technical adviser.

sections.label: Wind in operation
sections.title: Wind turbines in operation
sections.intro: Blade damage starts small and gets expensive. Aerata inspects each turbine with a short stop and no rope access, so you find damage while the repair is still minor and plan it around your wind and maintenance calendar.

items.text: Cracks, lightning damage, coating loss and leading-edge erosion, located along every blade.
Corrosion, coating condition and oil leaks visible from outside on the tower and the nacelle (the housing on top of the tower).
Thermal checks of cabinets and panels and, where housed there, the converter and transformer.
See which defects are growing from one inspection to the next.

sections.closing: Start with a pilot on a few turbines and see the results on your own site. The strongest moments to inspect are before the manufacturer warranty ends, after lightning or storms, and before a sale.

sections.label: Wind construction
sections.title: Wind farm construction
sections.intro: Roads, crane pads, foundations and cable trenches are where wind projects hide their costs. Aerata measures them independently, so you can check what you are paying for and record the work before it is buried.

items.text: Measured at every turbine position and at the substation.
Volumes for roads and crane pads, and slope movement between visits.
Foundations and medium-voltage trenches recorded before backfilling, with position checked against the design.
Slope and vegetation restoration documented against the original ground, for permit conditions.
For blade and tower transport and for the grid connection line.
Turbine inspection at handover, light-load drone delivery to places with no road access (subject to flight approval), and security for stored components.

receive.title: Fault report to IEC TS 62446-3
receive.desc: Every anomaly classified, photographed in thermal and RGB, and located by section, row and string.

receive.title: Fault list for your O&M system
receive.desc: One line per fault with coordinates, ready to import and assign.

receive.title: Report per turbine and per blade
receive.desc: Each finding with its position along the blade, side and photo, ready for your repair planning.

receive.title: Construction records
receive.desc: Progress per section and turbine position, volumes, as-built checks and before-backfill records, with timelapse.

grid.seoDesc: Drone surveys of medium- and high-voltage lines, substations and telecom masts: lean, clearances, vegetation, hot connections and 3D models of each structure.
grid.heroSub: Survey the whole network from the air, so climbs, outages and crews go where the evidence says they are needed.

card.o1: Every pole and pylon measured for position, height and lean
card.o2: Vegetation inside your clearance distance mapped before the fire season
card.o3: Fewer climbs, and crews arrive with the right parts

sections.label: Medium voltage
sections.title: Medium-voltage power lines
sections.intro: A leaning pole or a tree too close to a conductor means outages, fire risk and liability. Aerata surveys the whole line, so your crews go straight to the poles and trees that matter instead of driving the route.

items.text: Position, height and lean, so the worst can be reached first.
Trees and vegetation inside your clearance distance, located on the map before the fire season.
To the ground, roads and buildings on the day of flight.
Insulators, cross-arms and fittings checked close up, and hot connections found while the line is under load.
A rapid check of the affected section with live video to your control room.
Substation inspection after a site study, and light-load delivery to poles with no road access, subject to flight approval.

sections.label: High voltage
sections.title: High-voltage lines and substations
sections.intro: Climbing every pylon is slow, costly and dangerous. Aerata looks first, so climbs and outages are planned around evidence and crews arrive with the right parts and work lists.

items.text: Position, height and lean.
Insulator strings, cross-arms, fittings, spacers and dampers, earth wire and aviation marker balls.
Corrosion, missing members and bird nests.
Found while the line carries load.
Vegetation and conductor clearances along the route.
After a site study, transformers, circuit breakers, disconnectors, busbars and connections, from positions your operator allows, plus a 3D model for planning extensions.
Rapid damage checks.

sections.closing: The work complements your existing climbing and helicopter programmes, with fewer climbs and better-prepared outages.

sections.label: Telecom
sections.title: Telecommunications
sections.intro: Sending climbers up a mast just to look at it costs time and puts people at risk. Aerata builds a remote record of each site, so you send crews only where there is a finding or a job.

items.text: With its tilt and the height and position of antennas, radio units and microwave dishes.
Antennas and equipment listed by sector.
Corrosion, bolting, missing members, guy wires, lightning protection, aviation lights, feeders and cable trays.
Radio and power equipment, including rectifiers, battery and power cabinets and generators at the base.
Surveys for new sites and fibre routes, and records before and after every upgrade.
Checks after storms or fire, and security against theft of batteries, fuel and copper at remote sites.

receive.desc: Every pole, pylon or mast with position, height, lean and findings, in route or site order.

receive.title: Vegetation and clearance maps
receive.desc: Trees and conductors closer than your clearance distance, ready for your vegetation contractor.

receive.title: Point clouds and 3D models
receive.desc: Classified LiDAR of the corridor and 3D models of masts and substations.

sections.label: Building construction
sections.title: Building construction
sections.intro: Disputes over progress, quantities and defects are expensive. Aerata ties payments to measured progress and records what was built before it is covered.

items.text: For site meetings and payment milestones, with timelapse.
Volumes by zone and period, measured from a baseline taken before work starts.
With trenches and foundations recorded before backfilling.

items.lead: Roof and façade inspection before handover
items.text: Visible damage, moisture and thermal bridges, while the contractor is still on site.
Drone washing of façades and roofs with water, delivery of light materials to sites without road access, and site security.

sections.label: Surveying & mapping
sections.title: Surveying and mapping
sections.intro: Current site data prevents redesign, delay and nasty surprises. Aerata surveys large and hard-to-reach land faster than a ground crew, with less exposure to steep or unsafe ground.

items.text: A map of the whole site that you can measure on and draw over in CAD or GIS.
Contours, cross-sections, profiles, and stockpile and excavation volumes on the survey date.
Where vegetation hides the ground.
Buildings, installations and monuments, with heights and dimensions (monuments only with Ministry of Culture permission).

sections.title: Mining, quarries and landfill

Progress against the mine plan and the licence boundary.
Width, gradients, safety berms and drainage.
Volume, filling rate and remaining capacity.

Live video to check the exclusion zone, then the blast pile volume and new face profile.
Restoration progress, settling and tailings ponds above the waterline, and thermal surface maps of landfills showing hot spots.

sections.label: Bridges, dams, roads & rail
sections.title: Infrastructure: bridges, dams, roads and rail
sections.intro: Public structures carry safety and liability responsibilities, and deterioration is cheapest to fix when found early. Aerata inspects from a distance, reducing the need for lifting equipment, traffic management and work at height.

items.text: Cracks, spalling (concrete flaking) and corrosion on piers, abutments, beams and decks, plus bearings, expansion joints and deck drainage, each finding located on the structure.
A 3D model of the structure as a baseline for later comparison.
Downstream face, crest and spillway, surface anomalies, and thermal indications of seepage above the waterline.
Surface condition, cross-sections, slopes and drainage, an inventory of signs, barriers and lighting, and vegetation near the railway line.
Slope, landslide and rockfall monitoring, and rapid mapping after floods, earthquakes or landslides.

sections.label: Oil, gas & industrial
sections.title: Oil, gas and industrial facilities
sections.intro: Scaffolding, rope access and shutdowns are among the biggest costs in industrial maintenance. Aerata shows you where access is really needed, so turnaround work lists, materials and scaffolding are planned in advance.

items.text: Tanks, chimneys, flares, pipe racks, steel structures, pressure vessel exteriors, silos and cooling towers, for visible corrosion, coating and support condition.
Heat loss and hot spots.
Third-party interference, ground erosion and vegetation.
Close-up thermal checks of electrical panels, motor control centres, motors, steam lines and steam traps.
Including rooftop solar, plus roof washing with water.
For planning extensions, and stockpile volumes of raw materials and products.
Live video to your emergency team after a fire or leak, from outside the danger zone and at their request.

sections.label: Maritime
sections.title: Ports, marinas and ships
sections.intro: Ports, marinas and ships are costly to inspect, and every day of downtime matters. Aerata looks at what is above the waterline from the air, which reduces work at height and over water and fits into short port stays.

items.lead: Quay walls, jetties, piers and breakwaters
items.text: Cracks, spalling, corrosion, displaced armour stones, and damage to fenders and bollards, each located on a 3D model.
Hull sides, decks, hatch covers, cranes, funnel and lifeboats for owners and superintendents, and the full outer hull in dry dock.
Cranes, lighting masts, lighthouses and warehouse roofs, with thermal checks of roofs, refrigerated container areas and electrical panels.
Port and marina maps, progress monitoring for new port works, and yearly shoreline comparison for coastal protection decisions.
Security for marinas and yards out of season, and support during a pollution incident when the Coast Guard requests it.

sections.label: Ski resorts
sections.title: Ski resorts
sections.intro: A lift that breaks down in season costs revenue and reputation. Aerata inspects your lifts pylon by pylon while they run without passengers, so your technicians know where to start before they climb.

items.text: Foundations, structure, platforms, cross-arms and heads, the pulley assemblies (sheave trains) and the rope as visible from outside, plus the stations.
Overheating found with thermal imaging.
Measured on every slope, compared with a snow-free survey, so snowmaking water and energy go where they are needed.
Roofs, façades and heat loss, safety nets, fences, snow cannons, pipes and telecom masts.
Tools, spares and supplies delivered to upper stations and refuges when there is no road, subject to flight approval, and security for the months without staff.

receive.title: Findings located on the structure

receive.title: Work lists for access
receive.desc: Where scaffolding, rope access or lifting is really needed, for planning turnarounds and repairs.

safety.seoTitle: Site Security Monitoring & Public Safety Drone Support | Aerata
safety.seoDesc: Kooi mobile camera units with 24/7 alarm monitoring, automated DJI Dock drone patrols, and live thermal drone support for fire, flood and rescue authorities.
safety.heroSub: Protect unstaffed sites around the clock, and give authorities live pictures and data before, during and after incidents.

card.o1: Kooi camera units and automated DJI Dock patrols, monitored 24/7
card.o2: Live thermal and zoom video to the coordination centre
card.o3: Damage records for police, insurers and ELGA

sections.label: Site security
sections.title: Site security and monitoring
sections.intro: Unstaffed sites, construction yards and remote assets are targets for theft and vandalism. Aerata combines fixed watch with eyes in the air: mobile camera units run with our partner Kooi, and automated drone patrols from a DJI Dock on site. Together they give you visible deterrence and remote monitoring around the clock, as a cost-effective alternative to permanent guarding for as long as you need it.

items.text: For sites with no staff and no mains power, with solar and hybrid options, bought or rented for permanent or temporary sites.
Alarms go to a 24/7 alarm-monitoring centre, where operators verify each alarm and follow your protocol: siren, a voice warning through the unit, and a call to a security company or the police.

A DJI Dock on site launches its drone on a schedule or when an alarm is raised, flies a set route with thermal and zoom cameras, and returns to recharge, with no one needed on site. Operated by Aerata within the flight approvals for each site.
A drone survey shows blind spots and the best camera positions before installation.
Fence and gate inspection, and documentation of damage after a break-in, vandalism or fire for the police and your insurer.
For storage of lithium batteries, waste and biomass, with availability confirmed for each site.

sections.closing: Cameras detect and alert, the drone verifies from the air. Response on site comes from licensed security providers, called in through the protocol you agree with us.

partner.name: Kooi
partner.text: Kooi, based in Drachten in the Netherlands, has supplied mobile camera security since 2010, starting in the wind industry. Its UFO camera units and RED fire early warning are connected to the Kooi Alarm Center, certified to the European standard EN 50518 for alarm-receiving centres. Aerata adds the drone side: the survey before installation and DJI Dock patrols that check alarms from the air, and brings the combined service to our clients in the Netherlands, Greece and the Balkans.

sections.label: Public safety
sections.title: Public safety
sections.intro: Authorities decide better and faster when they can see what is happening. Aerata supplies live pictures and data before, during and after incidents, working only on instruction from, and under the coordination of, the responsible authority.

items.text: Thermal and zoom video to your coordination centre during fires, floods and hazardous-material incidents, with coordinates of the fire front, people and hazards for ground teams.
Systematic thermal scanning of land and coastline, with the coordinates of each indication.
A burnt-area map and the hot spots that could reignite.
A map and 3D model of the affected area for your engineers.
Vegetation height and density near settlements and roads, firebreak widths, and watercourse maps showing blocked points.
For insurers and ELGA, the Greek agricultural insurance organisation.

receive.title: Security map and camera plan
receive.desc: Site boundary, blind spots and recommended camera positions from a drone survey.

receive.title: Verified alarm handling
receive.desc: Alarms checked by Kooi Alarm Center operators, with a drone from the DJI Dock to look from the air, and handled to your protocol.

receive.title: Live video and coordinates
receive.desc: Thermal and zoom video to the coordination centre, with coordinates for ground teams.

receive.title: Incident and damage maps
receive.desc: Burnt-area, flood and damage maps and records for authorities, police and insurers.

environmental.name: Environmental monitoring
environmental.menu: Habitat, water and crop monitoring with multispectral and thermal sensors.
environmental.seoTitle: Environmental Drone Monitoring: NDVI & Habitat Mapping | Aerata
environmental.seoDesc: Multispectral and thermal drone surveys for habitat mapping, water quality, biodiversity assessment and precision agriculture, delivered as GIS-ready data.
environmental.heroSub: High-resolution aerial surveys for habitat mapping, biodiversity assessment, water quality monitoring, and precision agriculture. Multispectral and thermal data collected at scale — delivered in compliance-ready GIS formats.

card.o1: Map 200+ hectares of terrain in one flight
card.o2: NDVI, thermal, and multispectral for compliance and planning
card.o3: Species ID and population counting via AI analysis

sections.label: Monitoring & assessment
sections.title: Environmental monitoring and assessment
sections.intro: Drone-based environmental monitoring delivers accurate habitat mapping, pollution detection, and comprehensive ecosystem assessments. Multi-spectral and thermal sensors provide the data resolution needed for informed conservation and regulatory compliance decisions.

items.text: Multi-spectral NDVI and classification mapping for habitat assessment, invasive species detection, and biodiversity baseline surveys in support of conservation and regulatory compliance.
Multispectral mapping of water bodies for chlorophyll-a, turbidity, and NDWI indices. Tracks seasonal change and identifies pollution gradients across reservoirs and catchments.
High-resolution orthomosaics and DSMs for coastal erosion monitoring, intertidal zone mapping, and protected habitat assessments.
Repeatable surveys of wetlands and forests, so change between seasons and years is measured, not estimated.
Maps and reports that support Natura 2000 assessments and environmental impact assessments (EIA).

sections.label: Biodiversity
sections.title: Biodiversity assessment
sections.intro: AI-driven analytics for species identification, population estimation, and change detection across protected areas and development site footprints. Drone surveys produce detailed maps and reports that support conservation planning and statutory ecological assessments.

items.text: AI-assisted identification of species from aerial imagery, checked by our analysts.
Population density estimated across the whole survey area, not from sample plots alone.
Surveys repeated over time and compared, so gains and losses are located on the map.
Biodiversity reports with maps your ecologists can open and work on directly.
Pre- and post-development assessments of a site footprint for statutory ecological reporting.

sections.label: Smart agriculture
sections.title: Smart agriculture and precision crop management
sections.intro: Optimise crop health, irrigation efficiency, and nutrient management with AI-powered drone analytics. NDVI, NDRE, and thermal mapping identify problem zones before they affect yield — enabling targeted intervention rather than blanket treatment.

items.text: NDVI and NDRE analysis shows where crops are under stress before it affects yield.
Thermal and multispectral mapping of irrigation efficiency and water stress across each field.
Zones with nutrient deficiency or disease risk located for targeted inspection.
NDVI, NDRE, and thermal crop health mapping for targeted irrigation, fertiliser, and intervention planning — delivered as prescription maps for field machinery.
Recommendations for where to act, instead of treating the whole field the same way.

how.title: Survey Design
how.desc: Sensor selection, flight altitude, GSD, and temporal frequency defined to match the environmental variable being monitored.

how.title: Multi-Sensor Data Capture
how.desc: Simultaneous RGB, thermal, and/or multispectral data capture at prescribed altitudes. Radiometric calibration panels captured at flight start and end.

how.title: Spectral Processing & Analysis
how.desc: Radiometrically corrected reflectance maps, index calculation (NDVI, NDWI, NDRE), and classification layers generated from raw data.

how.title: GIS Deliverables
how.desc: GeoTIFF rasters, shapefiles, and interpretation reports delivered in your required coordinate reference system for direct GIS import.

receive.title: Reflectance and index maps
receive.desc: Radiometrically corrected maps with NDVI, NDWI and NDRE layers, in your coordinate reference system.

receive.title: Classification and habitat layers
receive.desc: Habitat, land-cover and change layers ready for direct GIS import.

receive.title: Prescription maps
receive.desc: Treatment zones for fertiliser, irrigation or spraying, for your field machinery.

receive.title: Interpretation reports
receive.desc: What the data shows, where, and what changed since the last survey.

cookies.title: Cookies on this site

With your permission we also use analytics cookies (Google Analytics, HubSpot) to measure visits, and marketing cookies (HubSpot, Google Ads) to measure our campaigns. You can change your choice at any time via 'Cookie settings' at the bottom of every page.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Needed for the site to work, such as remembering this choice. Always on.
cookies.analyticsDesc: Google Analytics and HubSpot measure how the site is used, so we can improve it.
cookies.marketingDesc: HubSpot and Google Ads measure whether our campaigns reach the right people.
